title: Why build v1.82.0-beta.3 is seen as 1.80.2.3442?
author: Alessio71
body_snippet:
Is not a real issue, is more a simple question, why build v1.82.0-beta.3 is seen as 1.80.2.3442?
When checking for updates it states that there is a newer version (1.81.0) available

Thanks,
Alex

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Hi @Alessio71! 

The version `1.80.2.3442` you're seeing is likely from an older build or a cached/stale installation. The current nightly builds show `1.82.0-beta.3` correctly.

To verify:
1. Download the latest nightly from https://github.com/robertpopa22/mRemoteNG/releases/tag/nightly
2. Check **Help → About** — should show `1.82.0-beta.3`
3. The Windows file properties (right-click → Properties → Details) shows `AssemblyFileVersion` which is `1.82.0.3435`

Regarding the update checker showin...
